subject: russian
core_principle: Keep the current trainer cards/answers/scoring unchanged. Resolve explanation content externally by trainer_item_id + result evidence + routing metadata.

fields.units: minimal learner-safe explanation units keyed by explanation_id
fields.routes: resolved routing metadata keyed by trainer_item_id or deterministic route key

fields.route_id: stable route id, usually based on trainer_item_id plus optional position/option key
fields.trainer_item_id: existing stable current trainer item id when route is item-specific
fields.precision: task | item | option | word | position | match_position | criterion_component

result_evidence_contract.note: This describes the data an integration adapter may read from the current trainer result. It does NOT authorize changing scoring.

warmup.before_answer: optional short_rule/rule drawer only when future warmup explicitly enables it

runtime_resolution_order: use exact result evidence if route status enabled and precision matches
otherwise choose safe candidate/fallback at task level
never infer exception/subskill from total score when item is mixed
preserve current trainer explanation as fallback when external content cannot resolve safely
excluded_from_runtime_payload: hidden source answer banks unrelated to current evaluation
answer_integrity: Runtime explanation payload never overrides the current trainer correct answer or score. If external explanation content conflicts with the trainer key, integration must fail closed and raise audit rather than silently changing either side.
